Kill [[Ilsundur, Lord of Fire]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Ilsundur, Lord of Fire in the [[Catacombs of Kathandrax]].
* *BONUS* Kill Ilsundur in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Ebon Vanguard Rank|Vanguard reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per [[Kathandrax's Crusher#Walkthrough|Kathandrax's Crusher]].
